source.branch: In cprefx(), PM_LIZARD calls fix_petrification() only when Stoned. The default acidic-flesh branch has the same Stoned guard. fix_petrification() chooses the Hallucination message, adding “fine ” when ACURR(A_CHA)>15, then calls make_stoned(0L, buf, 0, NULL) to clear the timeout, status, and delayed killer. start_eating() runs cprefx() before bite().
callers: eat.c:start_eating() calls cprefx(corpsenm) for a corpse or glob before bite(); js/eat.js:start_eating() reaches its cprefx().
potion.c:peffect_acid() and zap.c:zapyourself() also call fix_petrification(); their JS paths still refuse or skip the cure and require caller audit.
dependencies: potion.c:make_stoned() is ported in js/potion.js and owns STONED timeout, status, message and delayed-killer cleanup. The cure helper uses its void result.
The Hallucination/Charisma message branch reads ACURR(A_CHA); no core RNG draw occurs in fix_petrification().
